english.title: Make alteration in service pipe or attached apparatus by which water was supplied by licensee
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the consent of the water supply licensee, made an alteration, namely **(..SPECIFY ALTERATION..), in

(A)_[a service pipe]_
(B)_[apparatus, namely **(..SPECIFY APPARATUS..), attached to a service pipe]_

by means of which water was supplied by a water supply licensee to premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 174(3A)(c) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
